stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class): 25,021 applied, 17,035 admitted (68%), 1,754 enrolled (1,753 full-time + 1 part-time); counts from the NCES IPEDS 2025 Data Feedback Report, Figure 1 (chart data), and College Navigator shows the same 25,021 applicants, 68% admitted and 10% of admitted students enrolled. No usable Common Data Set: Hofstra posts its CDS (2025-2026 and earlier) only as image flipbooks on Issuu, which cannot be read as text, so the international applicant split, GPA distribution, waitlist, early-round counts and admission factors (CDS-only items) are left blank. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (438 students = 25% sent SAT, 65 = 4% sent ACT); Hofstra is test-optional. College Navigator gives no combined SAT total. Undergraduate enrollment (6,581) and the 255 U.S. nonresident undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2024 (College Navigator shows nonresidents as 4% of undergraduates); the 13-to-1 student-to-faculty ratio is from College Navigator. Calendar is semester (the bursar page bills Fall and Spring semesters).
